title: A novel system applying artificial intelligence in the identification of air leak sites.
summary: A computer-vision system detects intraoperative air-leak sites in surgical video using distinct training and test sets; 109 annotated sites form the test set, and the reported test includes 64 positive and 45 negative sites. External replication and prospective utility were not established.
ai_technology: Reference labels derive from conventional leak testing and expert site annotations; authors call the demonstration preliminary and it is not autonomous clinical outcome evidence.

evidence.tested: A computer-vision system detects intraoperative air-leak sites in surgical video using distinct training and test sets; 109 annotated sites form the test set, and the reported test includes 64 positive and 45 negative sites.
evidence.unknown: External replication, causal effects and prospective utility were not established in the reviewed material.
